claims.claim: The AMAs announced on May 20 that BTS will make a special live appearance at the 2026 ceremony.
The 52nd American Music Awards airs May 25 at 8 p.m. ET / 5 p.m. PT on CBS and Paramount+.
BTS are nominated for Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer for SWIM, and Best Male K-Pop Artist.
BTS won Artist of the Year at the AMAs in 2021.
BTS made their U.S. TV performance debut at the 2017 AMAs with DNA.
KATSEYE is included in the 2026 AMAs performer lineup.
KATSEYE received nominations for New Artist of the Year, Breakthrough Pop Artist, and Best Music Video for Gnarly.
Best Male K-Pop Artist nominees include ATEEZ, ENHYPEN, Stray Kids, TXT, and BTS.
